risks.label: Strait of Hormuz Blockade — Week 6
risks.detail: Iran's blockade of the Strait of Hormuz enters its sixth week. ~500M barrels of petroleum products kept off global markets. Brent crude above $112. This is the single biggest macro risk variable globally. OECD forecasts G20 inflation at 4% for 2026.

risks.label: Oil-Driven Inflation Accelerating
risks.detail: Brent above $112, up from $105 a week ago. US inflation potentially exceeding 4.2% per OECD. Fed stuck — can't cut rates with energy inflation. March CPI (Apr 9) is the next critical data point.

risks.label: NFP Gap Risk — Data on Closed Market
risks.detail: March Non-Farm Payrolls released on Good Friday with equity markets closed. Full reaction deferred to Monday's open. Creates gap risk event. ADP showed +62K (beat), suggesting resilient labor market.

risks.label: S&P 500 Still -9.1% From January ATH
risks.detail: Despite three-day relief rally, S&P at 5,892 remains well below its January 27 high near 6,489. March was -5% for SPX, Nasdaq, and Dow. Counter-trend rally or genuine recovery?

risks.label: IRGC Escalation Despite Peace Signals
risks.detail: Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps announced targeting of US companies in the region, contradicting Trump's 2-3 week de-escalation timeline. Mixed signals create binary risk for oil and defense sectors.

events.label: March CPI — April 9
events.detail: The most important data point of next week. Energy costs flowing through supply chain. Consensus 3.8% y/y. A hot print kills any remaining rate cut hopes for 2026. Market-moving.

events.label: FOMC Minutes — April 8
events.detail: Minutes from the March meeting. How hawkish was the discussion? Oil-driven inflation complicates the Fed's path. Any mention of rate hike risks would shake markets.

events.label: Q1 Bank Earnings — April 11
events.detail: JPMorgan, Wells Fargo, BlackRock kick off Q1 earnings season. Watch loan loss provisions for credit stress and trading revenue (war volatility = trading bonanza).

events.label: ISM Services PMI — April 6 (Monday)
events.detail: Manufacturing already at 52.7 (3-month expansion). If services also beats, soft landing narrative strengthens significantly. First market day post-NFP.

events.label: Delta Airlines Earnings — April 9
events.detail: First airline to report Q1. Jet fuel costs surging with Brent above $112. Guidance will reveal how airlines are absorbing the energy shock. Bellwether for transport sector.

opportunities.label: Small Cap Rotation (IWM) — Great Rotation
opportunities.detail: Russell 2000 seeing massive inflows ($1.7B single day). Valuations at 30-year discount to large caps. ISM Manufacturing expansion favors domestic small caps. YTD +12% vs S&P +1.5%.

opportunities.label: Gold Recovery — $4,769 and Rising
opportunities.detail: Gold recovering from March correction ($5,312 → $4,578 → $4,769). Geopolitical safe-haven + weaker dollar + declining real rates. Target $5,000+ on Hormuz resolution failure.

opportunities.label: Defense Stocks — Record Highs
opportunities.detail: LMT, NOC, RTX hitting all-time highs. Global defense procurement cycles accelerating. Iran conflict driving sustained spending increases. Multi-year tailwind.

opportunities.label: Energy Producers — Supply Dislocation Beneficiaries
opportunities.detail: XOM, CVX, COP outperforming with Brent above $112. North American E&P names are the biggest winners of the Hormuz blockade. Cash flows at record levels.

opportunities.label: BTC Extreme Fear — Contrarian Setup
opportunities.detail: Fear & Greed at 24 (Extreme Fear) for 7 consecutive weeks. Whale accumulation ongoing (30K+ BTC to cold storage). Extended extreme fear historically precedes major bottoms.

regime_items.label: Early Risk-Off — VIX Declining but Still Elevated
regime_items.detail: VIX at 19.42, down from 25+ Monday but still above the 15-20 neutral zone. Regime score 0.48. The relief rally is reducing fear but hasn't reversed the risk-off posture.

regime_items.label: $8 Trillion in Money Market Funds
regime_items.detail: Record cash on the sidelines. This is both a fear indicator and massive dry powder. A resolution of Hormuz or clear de-escalation could trigger rapid redeployment into equities.

regime_items.label: ISM Manufacturing Expansion — 3 Months Above 50
regime_items.detail: ISM at 52.7, the best reading since summer 2022. Manufacturing is expanding despite oil headwinds. ADP +62K and Retail Sales +0.6% beat. Economic fundamentals are surprisingly strong.

regime_items.label: Fed Policy Paralysis
regime_items.detail: The Fed is stuck. Oil-driven inflation prevents rate cuts. Strong economic data prevents recession response. March CPI (Apr 9) will determine if the Fed pivots hawkish. Policy uncertainty is a regime risk.
